title: IF-GUIDE: Influence Function-Guided Detoxification of LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating Expected Maximum Toxicity (EMT) and Toxicity Probability (TP) on text completions from the RealToxicityPrompts and AttaQ datasets using the Detoxify classifier.

Generating completions for the BOLD (Bias in Open-Ended Language Generation) dataset and measuring toxicity scores, as well as explicitly tracking the 'Identity Attack' subtype using the Detoxify classifier.
Scoring model generations with the ToxiGen-RoBERTa classifier to detect subtle forms of toxicity, such as microaggressions and stereotyping that arise in otherwise non-toxic contexts.
